name: MATLI v1.4 Ayurveda Personalization & Selection Intelligence
mode: Clinician-learning + formulary discovery + patient-context bridge + situation-aware safety + formulation comparison
safety_boundary: Complaint is not diagnosis; symptom-only mode must not generate an automatic prescription.
Ayurvedic treatment is individualized by diagnosis, Dosha/Vikriti, Agni, Ama, Koshtha, Bala, stage, age, pregnancy and comorbidity.
This build does not guess classical doses. Dose/anupana auto-fill is blocked unless a future exact source-verified dose layer is present.
Rasaushadhi, Bhasma, Lauha/Mandura, Kshara and other high-caution formulations require explicit expert review and product-quality verification.
No brand/manufacturer is ranked as best or safest; classical name is canonical.
No local safety rule triggered does not mean a formulation is safe for an individual patient.

priority_legend.green: Evidence-linked/classical candidate in the encoded context — clinician review still required
